refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: a = levinson(r) a = levinson(r,n) [a,e] = levinson(r,n) [a,e,k] = levinson(r,n)

listitem.para: the coefficients of a length(r)-1 order autoregressive linear process
the prediction error when order is n
a column vector containing the reflection coefficients of length n

refsection.title: Examples
refsection.programlisting:
a = [1 0.1 -0.8] //Estimate the coefficients of an autoregressive process given by x(n) = 0.1x(n-1) - 0.8x(n-2) + w(n)
v = 0.4 w = sqrt(v)*rand(15000,1,"normal") x = filter(1,a,w)
[r,lg] = xcorr(x,'biased') r(lg<0) = []
ar = levinson(r,length(a)-1)
